mask_tips1.zh: RS监控2个选定的键,并激活按下的键。例如,当A键被按下时,如果D键比A键按得更深,则D键会立即激活。一旦您释放了D键,A键就会激活。
mask_tips1.en: RS monitors 2 selected keys and activates the pressed key. For example, when the A key is pressed, if the D key is pressed deeper than the A key, the D key will be activated immediately. Once you release the D key, the A key will activate.

mask_tips2.zh: SOCD指的是一种技术，用于处理同时按下对立方向键时的输入。具体来说，当玩家在操作设备时，如果同时按下两个方向键（如上和下，左和右），SOCD 技术会根据设定的规则或算法来决定如何处理这些输入，以避免冲突或错误。
mask_tips2.en: SOCD refers to a technique used to handle inputs when opposite direction keys are pressed simultaneously. Specifically, when a player operates the device and presses two direction keys at the same time (such as up and down, left and right), the SOCD technique determines how to process these inputs based on set rules or algorithms to avoid conflicts or errors.

mask_tips3.zh:
单个按键实现 4 种功能：您可以根据4种不同的按压程度绑定 1 至 4 种功能。拖放按键到您想要的键位上即可绑定动态键程键。

您可以选择两种方式：点击 “ + “ 图案实现单次触发（只触发一次），或是拖动黄点跨过数个 ”+“ 图案复现正常的按键触发行为。如果您要重复某个动作，只需回到原本键程位置即可继续，不需要完成整个键程设置。

小技巧：利用此功能，您可以用一个按键同时做出 2 种移动方式：在基本移动键（通常是WASD）的第二个功能格子里绑定游戏中的冲刺键（通常是Shift），然后拖动黄点跨过第二个（按压触底）和第三个（按压触底时抬起）“+”形成黄线，如此即可在基本移动的基础上同时移动与冲刺。
mask_tips3.en:
Single key to achieve 4 functions: You can bind 1 to 4 functions according to 4 different pressing degrees. Drag and drop the key to the key position you want to bind the dynamic keystroke key. 

You can choose two ways: Click on the + pattern to achieve single triggering (trigger only once), or drag the yellow dot across several + patterns to reproduce the normal key triggering behavior. If you want to repeat an action, you only need to return to the original keystroke position to continue, and there is no need to complete the entire keystroke setting. 

Tip: Using this function, you can use one key to simultaneously perform 2 types of movement methods: Bind the sprint key (usually Shift) in the second function grid of the basic movement key (usually WASD), and then drag the yellow dot across the second (press to the bottom) and the third (lift when pressing to the bottom) + to form a yellow line, so that you can move and sprint simultaneously on the basis of the basic movement.

mask_tips4.zh:
单个按键实现 2 种功能：按住按键为一种，单击按键为另一种。拖放按键到您想要的键位上即可绑定双效点击键。

如果“按住”绑定的是修饰键与另一个键的组合的话，按住会立即触发。除非另一个键也是双效点击键。

小技巧：可以将您键盘右下的四个修饰键改为MT键，这样按住时可以是原本修饰键的功能，单击的时候则是方向键。
mask_tips4.en:
A single button realizes two functions: holding the button is one, and single-clicking the button is another. Drag and drop the button to the key position you want to bind it as the double-click key.

If the 'holding' is bound to a combination of a modifier key and another key, it will be triggered immediately when held. Unless another key is also a double-click key.

Tip: You can change the four modifier keys on the lower right of your keyboard to MT keys, so that when held, it can be the function of the original modifier key, and when clicked, it is the direction key.

mask_tips5.zh:
单击按键可切换开启或关闭持续触发。按住按键则为正常触发行为。拖放按键到您想要的键位上即可绑定切换开关键。

单击按键相当于锁定按键于触发位置。按住后放开按键则为原本正常的按键输入。

提示：游戏中蹲下键（通常是C键）可使用此功能。该绑定键就能同时实现蹲下（按住）以及蹲下（切换）
mask_tips5.en:
Single-click the button to switch between enabling or disabling continuous triggering. Pressing the button holds it in the normal triggering behavior. Drag and drop the button to the key position you want to bind it as the toggle switch key.

Single-clicking the button is like locking the button at the triggered position. Pressing and then releasing the button is the original normal key input.

Tip: The crouch key (usually the C key) in a game can use this function. This bound key can simultaneously achieve crouching (holding) and crouching (switching).

mask_tips7.zh: 单个按键实现按下和松开两种不同功能：按下时触发一个按键功能，松开时触发另一个按键功能。
mask_tips7.en: A single button implements two different functions of pressing and releasing: one button function is triggered when pressed, and another button function is triggered when released.

mask_tips8.zh: MPT功能为按键设置三档不同的行程，并在三个不同的行程分配不同的按键。当按键按压大于一段行程，则按下对应行程的按键；当按键抬起小于一段行程，则抬起对应行程的按键。
mask_tips8.en:
The MPT function sets three different strokes for the keys and assigns different keys to the three different strokes. 
When the button is pressed for more than a certain stroke, the button corresponding to the stroke is pressed; when the button is lifted less than a certain stroke, the button corresponding to the stroke is lifted.

release_point_desc.en: Selects the paragraph position used when the current key is released.

remap_text_1.zh: 在此处所作的更改将会影响此配置文件和其他关联的配置文件
remap_text_1.en: Changes made here will affect this configuration file and other related configuration files.

remap_text_2.zh: 要重新映射任何按键，只需将右边的按键选中并拖放到您的键盘。或者在下方选择一个预设。
remap_text_2.en: To remap any key, simply select a key on the right and drag and drop it to your keyboard. Or choose a preset below.

reset_message.zh: 你确定要重置吗？这将重置键盘全部设置。
reset_message.en: Are you sure you want to reset? This will reset all keyboard settings.

resettingAllText2.zh: 有些时候您会想直接/remake得了
resettingAllText2.en: Sometimes you may want to just /remake it

rt_error.zh: 不建议设置值小于0.04mm，会因手指轻微抖动而判定为按键释放
rt_error.en: It is not recommended to set the value below 0.04mm, as slight finger movements may be interpreted as a key release.

rt_mode_text.zh: 开启狂暴模式下精度更极限，更换更好的轴体会更稳定不断触（轴体性能不达标会有断触风险）配合混轴功能玩法，需要相对应的进行轴体校准页面进行精度校准
rt_mode_text.en: When Rampage Mode is activated, the precision becomes even more extreme. Switching to better switches will ensure more stable contact (switches not meeting performance standards may risk intermittent contact). This mode works in conjunction with the mixed switch functionality, requiring corresponding calibration of switch precision on the appropriate page.

screen_text15.en: Do you want to delete this video?

screen_text16.en: At least one frame needs to be retained

screen_text17.en: Are you sure you want to delete the current frame?

screen_text22.zh: 这可能需要一些时间，请不要关闭页面
screen_text22.en: This may take some time, please do not close the page

screen_text7.zh: 无效的图片文件：没有找到有效帧
screen_text7.en: Invalid image file: no valid frame found

screen_text9.zh: 图片解析失败：未能提取有效帧
screen_text9.en: Image parsing failed: Failed to extract valid frame

senior_btn_text1.zh: Rappy Snappy 监控所选的两个按键，并激活按下较深的按键。
senior_btn_text1.en: Rappy Snappy monitors the 2 selected keys and activates whichever key is pressed down further.

senior_btn_text2.zh: SOCD 监控所选的两个按键，并根据您选择的设定激活它们。
senior_btn_text2.en: SOCD monitors the 2 selected keys and activates them based on your chosen settings.

senior_btn_text3.zh: 单个按键实现 4 种功能：您可以根据4种不同的按压程度绑定 1 至 4 种功能。
senior_btn_text3.en: A single key can achieve 4 functions: you can bind 1 to 4 functions based on 4 different pressure levels.

senior_btn_text4.zh: 单个按键实现 2 种功能：按住按键为一种，单击按键为另一种。
senior_btn_text4.en: A single key can achieve 2 functions: holding the key is one function, clicking the key is another.

senior_btn_text5.zh: 单击按键可切换开启或关闭持续触发。按住按键则为正常触发行为。
senior_btn_text5.en: Clicking the key can toggle continuous triggering on or off. Holding the key will trigger normally.

senior_btn_text6.zh: 一键触发多个修饰键与单个常规按键组合成组合指令
senior_btn_text6.en: One-click triggers multiple modifier keys and a single conventional key to combine into a combined command

senior_btn_text7.zh: 单个按键实现 2 种功能：按下按键为一种，松开按键为另一种。
senior_btn_text7.en: A single button performs 2 functions: one when pressed, and the other when released.

senior_btn_text8.zh: 单个按键设置三档不同行程，按压深度达到对应行程时触发对应功能。
senior_btn_text8.en: A single button is set with three different strokes, and the corresponding function is triggered when the pressing depth reaches the corresponding stroke.

senior_mask1.zh: Rappy Snappy monitors the 2 selected keys and activates whichever key is pressed down further.
senior_mask1.en: Rappy Snappy monitors the 2 selected keys and activates whichever key is pressed down further.

senior_mask2.zh: SOCD monitors the 2 selected keys and activates them based on your chosen settings.
senior_mask2.en: SOCD monitors the 2 selected keys and activates them based on your chosen settings.

senior_mask4.zh: 单个按键实现 2 种功能：按住按键为一种，单击按键为另一种。
senior_mask4.en: A single key can achieve 2 functions: holding the key is one function, clicking the key is another.

senior_mask5.zh: 单击按键可切换开启或关闭持续触发。按住按键则为正常触发行为。
senior_mask5.en: Clicking the key can toggle continuous triggering on or off. Holding the key will trigger normally.

senior_text.zh: 首先选择任意按键来绑定高级键。每个配置文件最多可使用40个高级键。一个高级键不能在单个按键上的多个层加，但可以在不同的层上绑定
senior_text.en: First, select any key to bind advanced keys. Each configuration file can use up to 40 advanced keys. An advanced key cannot be added to multiple layers on a single key but can be bound on different layers.

senior_tips.zh: 从键盘或上面的预览中选择一个键进行分配
senior_tips.en: Select a key from the your keyboard or the preview above to assign to

sensitive_text_1.zh: 灵敏度决定了您松开按键重置和再次按下按键触发所需的行程
sensitive_text_1.en: Sensitivity determines the distance required for resetting when releasing a key and triggering again when pressing a key.

sensitive_text_2.zh: 处于快速触发模式时，如果按键已触发，只要抬起指定的距离按键就会松开
sensitive_text_2.en: In fast trigger mode, if the key has been triggered, it will release as long as you lift it a specified distance.

sensitive_text_3.zh: 处于快速触发模式时，如果按键未触发，只要按下指定的距离按键就会触发。
sensitive_text_3.en: In quick trigger mode, if the key is not triggered, it will trigger as long as the specified distance is pressed.

separate_style.zh: 单独设置松开和按下的灵敏度
separate_style.en: Independently set release and press sensitivity

set_tips_text.zh: 升级完固件后,键盘必须手动重新校准一遍
set_tips_text.en: After upgrading the firmware, the keyboard must be manually recalibrated

socd_select_text1.zh: 最后激活的按键会覆盖之前的按键
socd_select_text1.en: The last activated key will override the previous key.

socd_select_text2.en: Key 1 always takes precedence over Key 2.

socd_select_text3.en: Key 2 always takes precedence over Key 1.

socd_select_text4.zh: 当两个按键都被激活时，都不会被触发
socd_select_text4.en: When both keys are activated, neither will be triggered.

stabilize_text.zh: 极限参数下，打开稳定性模式后，优化按键算法，提升键盘整体稳定性
stabilize_text.en: Under extreme parameters, enabling stability mode optimizes the key algorithm, enhancing overall keyboard stability.

stage_axis_desc.zh: 支持段落触发和松开自定义。
stage_axis_desc.en: Supports paragraph trigger and release customization.

switch_axis_desc.zh: 先选择键盘上的按键，再批量设置这些按键的轴体类型。
switch_axis_desc.en: First select the keys on the keyboard, and then set the shaft types of these keys in batches.

switch_axle.en: Do you need to switch the switch type?

trigger_current_selection_desc.zh: 选中一个或多个按键后，可以设置触发点和快速触发。
trigger_current_selection_desc.en: After selecting one or more keys, you can set trigger points and quick triggers.

trigger_point_desc.zh: 选择当前按键触发时使用的段落位置。
trigger_point_desc.en: Select the paragraph position used when the current key is triggered.

trigger_settings_desc.zh: 为段落触发轴设置触发点，并按需开启快速触发。
trigger_settings_desc.en: Set the trigger point for the paragraph trigger axis and enable quick triggering as needed.

trigger_settings_desc2.zh: 设置前，请先选择一些按键。
trigger_settings_desc2.en: Before setting, please select some keys.

trigger_settings_normal_axis_tip.zh: 当前为常规轴体，不支持自定义触发设置，请先切换为段落轴体。
trigger_settings_normal_axis_tip.en: It is currently a regular axis and does not support custom trigger settings. Please switch to a paragraph axis first.

unable_profile_file_format.zh: 无法获取当前 profile 配置
unable_profile_file_format.en: Unable to get the current profile configuration

upadte_tips.zh: 升级包仅限于win系统运行
upadte_tips.en: The upgrade package is only for Windows systems.

whole_text.zh: 启用时,快速触发功能将一直生效,禁用时,快速触发需要按键到达触发键程后再生效。
whole_text.en: When enabled, the quick trigger function will remain active; when disabled, the quick trigger will only take effect after the key reaches the trigger travel.

window_too_small_message.zh: 请调整窗口大小或使用浏览器缩放（Ctrl + -），以获得更佳体验。
window_too_small_message.en: Please resize the window or use browser zoom (Ctrl -) for a better experience.

write_success.en: Write successful, check in profile list
